question: Which countries are collaborating for the Chandrayaan-5 mission, as announced by ISRO in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India and Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chandrayaan-5** mission, also known as the **Lunar Polar Exploration (LUPEX)** mission, is a joint robotic lunar mission by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** and the **Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA)**.
 
• As announced in **March 2025**, the mission specifically targets the **Lunar South Pole**, a region believed to contain significant deposits of **water ice** in permanently shadowed craters.
 
• Under this bilateral agreement, **ISRO** is tasked with the development of the **Lunar Lander**, leveraging the technical success achieved during the **Chandrayaan-3** mission.
 
• **JAXA** is responsible for providing the **Lunar Rover** and the **H3 Rocket**, which will serve as the **launch vehicle** for the mission.
